violated_contract: A mobile production release must publish the tag's marketing version under a store build number no upload has already consumed. Google Play version codes are global and immutable, so a prod lane that pins the tag's build number without checking the live store floor collides with codes the internal-auto lane keeps allocating (floor + 1) after the tag is cut, and the publish is rejected with 'Version code has already been used'.
canonical_prevention: Resolve the prod Android build number against the live Play floor at build time: keep the tag number while it is above the floor, otherwise allocate floor + 1, and fail closed on lookup or parse errors by reusing the auto lane's strict store-output parsing. The tag stays authoritative for the marketing version and as the minimum build number.
